text: the honourable man: Heb. a man eminent in countenance | eloquent orator: Or, skillfull of speech
shall he swear: Heb. lift up the hand | healer: Heb. binder up
given him: Heb. done to him
they which lead thee: Or, they which call thee blessed | destroy: Heb. swallow up
wanton eyes: Heb. deceiving with their eyes | mincing: Or, tripping nicely
chains: Or, sweet balls | mufflers: Or, spangled ornaments
tablets: Heb. houses of the soul
